nodes.label: Python Service Pattern — FastAPI src/ layout with pydantic-settings
nodes.rationale: Uniform layout (main.py + settings.py + conftest.py) across all five Python services reduces cognitive overhead and ensures consistent env-var injection via pydantic-settings prefixes.
nodes.norm_label: python service pattern — fastapi src/ layout with pydantic-settings

nodes.label: OpenAI-Compatible /v1/chat/completions API
nodes.rationale: Exposing an OpenAI-compatible endpoint means every existing application works with zero code changes, removing adoption friction.

nodes.label: SHA-256 API Key Hashing Policy
nodes.rationale: Never storing plaintext API keys — only SHA-256 hex digests — prevents credential exposure if the database is compromised.

nodes.label: Async-First FastAPI Design Principle
nodes.rationale: All services use httpx.AsyncClient, asyncpg, and async SQLAlchemy to avoid blocking I/O in request handlers, ensuring high throughput under concurrent AI workloads.

nodes.label: Helm-First Deployment Strategy
nodes.rationale: Everything as a Helm chart means the control plane calls helm upgrade --install for every resource, giving users standard Kubernetes primitives and no proprietary deploy abstraction.
